verdict.rationale: Programmatic management is a fair question for a security key, so the axis applies. The pack shows an official solo2 CLI with commands for listing devices, updating firmware and setting LEDs. It never documents an API, and it never claims the programmatic surface matches a management UI. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no technical llms.txt, so parity with the UI is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
